determinism: No randomness, floating point, time limit, node limit, or external solver.
memory_measurement: Linux resource.getrusage(RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss, KiB; maximum reported process footprint, not the sum over concurrent audit workers.

audit_partitioning.merge: increasing root id; all 704 indices required

independent_prototype_comparison.optimization: For the last block of a larger point-star bundle, intersect the incidence sets of all remaining triples instead of trying every block; also apply the necessary ten-triples-per-block bound. This reduces bundle states, preserving all point states and configuration sets.
independent_prototype_comparison.independence: Different full point-bijection join enumeration and whole-point-star completion branching. Both methods share LINKS.json and the mathematical point-link reduction; this is not external peer review.

reference_generation: The measured full runs used --write-reference. Default entry points independently regenerate and compare these compact reference values.
trust_boundaries: Completeness of the imported 107-class catalogue, including its upstream maximum-degree-five theorem.
Unformalized finite reduction and exhaustive Python implementations.
Earlier exceptional-profile exclusion is additionally required only for the balanced-profile corollary.
large_artifacts: No exhaustive joined-configuration dump, search log, or private ledger is published; all cases regenerate from source.
